tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the agent. Full pipeline (schema, queries, analysis). Sync within deadline_seconds; else {status:pending,job_id} — poll request_status/read_response. Pass a stable thread id (UUID) on every call for conversation context. The result carries thread_id, the thread actually used; re-send that value on later calls.

agent.description: Bundle name. Inferred from the Host header when missing.

message.description: User prompt for the agent. Either `message` or the legacy `question` alias must be set.

publisher_id.description: Publisher the research is bound to. Only the dedicated research credential may send it; other callers are refused.

question.description: Legacy apples-compat alias for `message`. Ignored when `message` is set.

role.description: Optional role override; defaults to admin for MCP callers.

thread.description: Persistent conversation id. Either `thread` or the legacy `thread_id` alias must be set.

thread_id.description: Legacy apples-compat alias for `thread`. Ignored when `thread` is set.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Short orientation text for apples MCP callers.

tools.name: read_response
tools.description: Stream a chunk of a pending ask() job's output.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a prior ask() call.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from. 0 for the beginning.

publisher_id.description: Publisher the research is bound to. Only the dedicated research credential may send it; other callers are refused.

tools.name: request_status
tools.description: Check the status of a pending ask() job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a prior ask() call that went async.

publisher_id.description: Publisher the research is bound to. Only the dedicated research credential may send it; other callers are refused.
